title: 第6章 周天行气法第7章 拒绝
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: “师兄，我是来拜入太虚剑观的新人，束脩已经缴纳。”
在叩响山门前的拜山钟没几个呼吸后，沈长青便看到有一名身着白袍，背负长剑的青年男子自山谷中的大道上走了出来。
“可有信物？”那青年男子停在山门后面，两人之间隔着一层薄薄的光幕。
沈长青将从方鸿手中得到的信物交了过去，不过在触碰到光幕时，他便无法再进分毫，倒是那信物穿了过去。
“果真是我剑观的师弟。”
青年男子伸出手将接过信物，扫了一眼后，脸上顿时挂起了笑意：“我叫宋子川，你可以叫我宋师兄。”
沈长青立马回应了一声，“是，宋师兄。”
“进来吧。”
宋子川抬手在光幕上点了一下，上面顿时裂开了一道能供一人通过的小口子。
这一刻，沈长青只觉的有一股通透入体、心境明澈空灵的神异感觉扑面而来，瞬息之间，他的心头便有了明悟：“这是纯净的灵气！”
他没有半分迟疑，当即一步踏了进去。
步入山门，眼前顿时换了新天地，而最直接的改变就是，天空不再是灰蒙蒙的，而是十分的清新透亮，好似水洗过一般。
置身于此，一呼一吸都足以令浑身通畅舒泰。
在这样的地方，才是真正的修行。
“跟我来吧。”
宋子川带着沈长青一路向着山谷深处走去，他问道：“想必师弟也是为太虚剑诀而来吧？”
沈长青收束心神，发现丝毫无法感受到宋子川的气息，更无法判断出修为，他开口道：“师弟听说太虚剑诀十分强大，能在临江府排进前三。”
“确切的说，临江府十大功法榜上目前在授的包括太虚剑诀在内的九大功法皆是各有长处，例如这太虚剑诀，便是以极致的攻伐能力著称。”
宋子川说的很公正，但语气中却带着骄傲，“不过你这么说也没错，综合来看，咱师傅的太虚剑诀在榜上确实是并列第二，修到极致甚至能力压首位的存在。”
“看来方鸿没骗我。”
沈长青心道一声果然，眼中尽是意动之色。
同样的束脩，去了东漓学宫多半是学不到这种级别的功法。
但下一刻，宋子川便是给他从头到脚浇了一盆冷水：“不过师弟现在怕是不能如愿了。”
沈长青面露疑惑，宋子川并没有解释，而是突然放缓了脚步，道：“至于原因，你马上就知道了。”
沈长青抬头看向前方，只见一个建立在青山脚下的硕大露天广场已然出现在了他的眼前。
广场有上万平方，上设百座镌刻着玄妙符文的灵台，此刻在那些灵台上，正有不少人盘坐修炼。
粗略一数，已有八九十人。
人很多，气氛却有些庄重紧迫，不显嘈杂，只偶尔才有几道交谈声响起。
而在广场的另一边，并排矗立着几座阁楼，在这几座阁楼的中间，则是一条可直上青山山腰的石梯。
“走吧，我带你去见师傅。”
宋子川带着沈长青从广场一侧的长廊走过，直至最后停在了一座颇为古典的阁楼前。
阁楼房门虚掩，飘出冉冉檀香。
宋子川推门走了进去，沈长青紧随其后。
阁楼内的陈设简单，两侧的武器架子上挂着长短不一、形式各异的长剑，材质以玄铁居多，而在中央，则是一方厚重的木桌。
这时，走在前面的宋子川突然喊了起来：“师傅，你又在看小人书！”
content_en:
"Senior brother, I am a newcomer to Taixu Sword Temple. I have already paid my dues."
A few breaths after ringing the mountain worship bell in front of the mountain gate, Shen Changqing saw a young man wearing a white robe and carrying a long sword walking out of the road in the valley.
"Do you have a token?" The young man stopped behind the mountain gate, with a thin light curtain between them.
"Yes."
Shen Changqing handed over the token he received from Fang Hong, but when he touched the light curtain, he could not advance any further, but the token passed through.
"He is indeed my junior brother from Jian Guan."
The young man stretched out his hand to take the token. After glancing at it, a smile suddenly appeared on his face: "My name is Song Zichuan, you can call me Senior Brother Song."
Shen Changqing immediately responded, "Yes, Senior Brother Song."
"Come in."
Song Zichuan raised his hand and clicked on the light curtain, and a small opening that could allow one person to pass through suddenly opened.
At this moment, Shen Changqing felt a mysterious feeling that penetrated his body and made his mind clear and ethereal. In an instant, he had a clear understanding in his heart: "This is pure spiritual energy!"
Without any hesitation, he immediately stepped in.
Stepping into the mountain gate, a new world suddenly changed before our eyes, and the most direct change was that the sky was no longer gray, but very fresh and translucent, as if it had been washed by water.
Being here, every breath and every breath is enough to make your whole body smooth and comfortable.
In a place like this, it is true practice.
"Come with me."
Song Zichuan led Shen Changqing all the way to the depths of the valley. He asked, "I must be that junior brother is also here for the Taixu Sword Art?"
Shen Changqing gathered his thoughts and found that he could not feel Song Zichuan's aura at all, let alone judge his cultivation level. He said: "Junior brother heard that the Taixu Sword Art is very powerful and can be ranked among the top three in Linjiang Mansion."
"To be precise, the nine major martial arts currently being taught on the list of the top ten martial arts in Linjiang Mansion, including the Taixu Sword Technique, all have their own strengths. For example, the Taixu Sword Technique is famous for its ultimate offensive ability."
Song Zichuan said it fairly, but with pride in his tone, "But you are right to say that. Taken together, our master's Taixu Sword Technique is indeed tied for second place on the list. The one who has mastered it to the extreme can even surpass the first place in ability."
"It seems that Fang Hong didn't lie to me."
Shen Changqing thought in his heart, and sure enough, his eyes were filled with emotion.
The same Shu Xiu would probably not be able to learn this level of skills if he went to Dongli Academy.
But the next moment, Song Zichuan poured a basin of cold water on him from head to toe: "But I'm afraid I won't be able to do what I want now."
Shen Changqing looked confused, but Song Zichuan did not explain, but suddenly slowed down and said, "As for the reason, you will know it soon."
Shen Changqing looked up and looked ahead, only to see a huge open-air square built at the foot of the green mountain already appearing in front of him.
The square covers tens of thousands of square meters, and there are hundreds of spiritual platforms engraved with mysterious runes. At this moment, many people are sitting cross-legged on those spiritual platforms and practicing.
At a rough count, there were eighty or ninety people.
There were a lot of people, but the atmosphere was somewhat solemn and urgent, not noisy, and only occasionally a few conversations could be heard.
On the other side of the square, there are several lofts standing side by side. In the middle of these lofts, there is a stone staircase that goes straight up to the mountainside of the green mountain.
"Let's go, I'll take you to see the master."
Song Zichuan led Shen Changqing through the corridor on one side of the square until they finally stopped in front of a rather classical attic.
The attic door was ajar, and sandalwood scent drifted out.
Song Zichuan opened the door and walked in, followed closely by Shen Changqing.
The furnishings in the attic are simple, with long swords of different lengths and shapes hanging on the weapon racks on both sides, mostly made of black iron, and in the center is a heavy wooden table.
At this time, Song Zichuan, who was walking in front, suddenly shouted: "Master, you are reading a little book again!"
